# Synthetic handwriting samples

These images are **synthetic**: the text was typed by the team and rendered in a handwriting-style font, then
blurred or printed to PDF. They show no real learner's handwriting. Never add real learner images to the repo.

- `clean.png`: four legible sentences.
- `blurry.png`: the same page, blurred until most words can't be read.
- `scan.pdf`: `clean.png` printed to an image-only PDF (no text layer).
